test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined words.

He was promoted to a higher position in the first year due to his __careful nature and hard-working efforts__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"diligence"** means careful and persistent work or effort. (परिश्रम)

 
 
• **Example:** Her **diligence** in completing the project ahead of time earned her a promotion.
 
 
 
• The correct word **"careful nature and hard-working efforts"** can be substituted with the word "diligence" in the context of the sentence.
 
 
• **Example:** He was promoted to a higher position in the first year due to his **diligence.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct one word substitution for the given phrase is **Diligence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Business mindedness** (व्यापारी दिमाग): Having a keen understanding and skill in commercial and trade activities.

 
 
• **Example:** His **business mindedness **helped the company turn a profit within the first year.
 
 
 
• **Extraordinary** (असाधारण): Very unusual or remarkable.
 
 
• **Example:** She showed **extraordinary** talent in musical instruments at a very young age.
 
 
 
• **Elegance** (शिष्टता): The quality of being graceful and stylish in appearance or manner.
 
 
• **Example:** Her **elegance** at the gala was widely admired.
